2.0.0-alpha.4: Color themes are back: choose Blue, Green, or Pink in Settings, in light or dark. The change applies instantly.
Choose the font and text size in Settings. Everything in the app, including dialogs, scales with it.
Keyboard shortcuts are back with the same defaults as CleanCutPDF 1.x (Ctrl+O Open PDF, Ctrl+E Export PDFs, Ctrl+F Search Logs, Ctrl+Shift+Z Undo Last Export, and more).
Change any shortcut in Settings: click it and press the new keys. CleanCutPDF warns you if the keys are already in use, and you can reset them all to the defaults.

New Reset Settings button returns settings, workspaces, and custom fields to the defaults after you type a short code. Your license, export history, open PDFs, and shortcuts are kept, and a backup is saved first.
Importing from CleanCutPDF 1.x now also brings over your color theme, font, text size, and keyboard shortcuts.
2.0.0-alpha.3: New Logs page: every exported or renamed file grouped by day and client, with search, workspace and date filters, and sorting. It stays fast with long histories.
Export the history to CSV, TSV, text, or PDF, or print it.
Undo Last Export moves the files from the most recent export to the Recycle Bin, so they can be restored.
Clear Log also moves the old history to the Recycle Bin instead of deleting it.
New 🔍 Zoom button opens the page in a large window: fit to width, Ctrl+scroll to zoom from 50% to 500%.
Save a printable SPLIT HERE sheet from the Inbox or Quick Split page.
Ctrl+Alt+D opens the debug console, which shows everything the app logs as it happens.
Fixed the Workspaces lists and editor resizing while scrolling or typing.
2.0.0-alpha.2: Split & Rename now works end to end: SPLIT HERE pages are found in the background (including colored separator sheets with no text), each Part gets the workspace fields, and Export PDFs saves one file per Part.
All field types are back: text, number, currency, date, dropdown (with Other), checkbox, and toggle, plus autofill, Today buttons, Payment Method → Check Number, notes, and the Aa button.
Exports remove blank pages, can make a client folder, never overwrite files, and record each file in the export history.
The Inbox has folders, multi-select, right-click actions, and Change Workspace / Move to Folder for many PDFs at once.
Open PDFs and everything typed into them are restored when the app starts again.
New Rename Only and Quick Split pages.
Workspace editing is back: create, rename, and delete workspaces, change the filename format with a live preview, choose and order fields, add notes, and create custom fields.
Import your workspaces, fields, settings, open PDFs, folder shortcuts, and export history from CleanCutPDF 1.x (1.x data is only read, never changed).
Folder shortcuts and client-name suggestions are back.
A diagnostic log now records what happened if something goes wrong (Settings › Diagnostics › Logs folder).
Closing the app is now instant and always saves your open PDFs first.
2.0.0-alpha.1: First preview of CleanCutPDF 2, rebuilt in C# with Avalonia for Windows and macOS.
PDF loading and page previews run in the background so the window never freezes.
Previews are cached, prefetched, and cancelled when you move on quickly.
Themes switch instantly without rebuilding the window.
Updates are checked in the background every time the app opens; the license is rechecked weekly. Neither delays startup.
